Founder requirement 2026-07-28: *"Any fail in the pipeline should notify me that the linear agent is broken if it is actually broken and why to do about it."*

Three words carry the whole spec: **actually** (no crying wolf), **broken** (not every unhappy path is breakage), and **what to do** (a page with no action is noise).

## What already exists — extend it, do not rebuild

`converge.sh` and `linear-worker.sh` already page through `slack-notify.sh` on 9 failures:

```
converge.sh:154  stopped, no PR after round N
converge.sh:164  VERDICT after N rounds, PR ready to merge
converge.sh:169  review produced no verdict on round N
converge.sh:180  stalled at VERDICT, no code change
converge.sh:188  hit N-round cap, still VERDICT
worker:170       git fetch failed -- the run did NO work
worker:412       approved but still DIRTY after N rebase rounds
worker:512       worktree does not hold the PR's commits
worker:659       stuck after N attempts
```

Reuse this channel (`founder-notifications.md`: `slack-notify.sh` is the only sanctioned sink, osascript is banned). Do not add a second notifier.

## Gap 1: the messages say WHAT, never WHAT TO DO

`"converge ASK-n: hit 3-round cap, still REQUEST CHANGES"` tells the founder something is wrong and leaves them to work out the rest at 3am. Every page must carry a **diagnosis** and a **next action**, ideally a runnable command.

```

GOOD  converge ASK-208 gave up after 3 rounds (scope too big -- 4 changes in one
      issue; 1-change issues converge in 1). PR #N left open, nothing merged.
      Do: split it. `kipi linear issue "<one change>"`, close ASK-208 as superseded.
```

## Gap 2: nothing watches from OUTSIDE, so a dead process reaches nobody

Every pager above lives *inside* the thing that fails. When the process dies, so does its ability to report. Proven tonight, twice:

* `linear-triage.py --apply` died on a Linear API `TimeoutError` after commenting on 74 issues and **closing 32**. Zero pages. Found only because a human read a log (`sp-b5dcf944`).
* A crashed reviewer reaches nobody at all (`sp-3a0cac1c`).

`launchd-health-check.py` already implements exactly this pattern for silent launchd job death. Extend that idea to the Linear pipeline rather than inventing a new watcher.

States only an outside observer can see:

* a PR with every required check GREEN that has not merged (auto-merge never armed) — the silent stall [ASK-222](https://linear.app/ask-consulting/issue/ASK-222/featworker-every-pr-the-worker-opens-arms-its-own-auto-merge-so-no) exists to prevent, and the one that most looks like success
* a PR with an approving verdict whose head sha nobody reviewed
* an issue `In Progress` with no branch and no PR, older than N hours (agent died holding work)
* a converge log whose last line is `dispatching` with no live process
* `main` red on `validate`

## Gap 3: "actually broken" — the classifier is the hard part

Most unhappy paths are the system **working**. Page on breakage, stay silent on normal:

| state | broken? | why |
| -- | -- | -- |
| REQUEST CHANGES on a round | **no** | the reviewer doing its job |
| PR waiting on review | **no** | normal latency |
| issue skipped, no DoR | **no** | a documented refusal |
| round cap hit, nothing merged | **yes** | work is stranded |
| reviewer crashed / no verdict | **yes** | the loop cannot proceed |
| worker infra error (auth, API down) | **yes** | environmental, nothing will self-heal |
| all checks green, not merged >20 min | **yes** | silent stall |
| agent died holding work, no PR | **yes** | work is lost unless someone looks |

**Blocks PR #23** ([ASK-210](https://linear.app/ask-consulting/issue/ASK-210/fixseam-a-linear-flow-pr-cannot-merge-without-a-prd-os-receipt-step-2), the receipt gate). ## The gap

PR #23 adds a blocking step to the `validate` job — the single required context on `main` — refusing any `sana/ask-<n>` branch with no prd-os receipt pinned to the PR head sha. **Nothing in the autonomous path writes one.** Verified, not assumed:

```
$ grep -rln "receipts.jsonl" plugins/ q-system/.q-system/scripts/
plugins/kipi-dsse/scripts/issue_runner.py     # reached only via /issue-closeout, a slash command
$ grep -n "closeout" q-system/.q-system/scripts/linear-worker.sh
637:6. Open a PR. DO NOT MERGE. DO NOT close the issue - closeout runs through /issue-verify and /issue-closeout.
$ tail -1 .prd-os/receipts.jsonl
{"closed_at": "2026-07-26T07:30:55Z", ... "prd_id": "prd-updater-consolidation-2026-07-26"}
```

The worker only *mentions* closeout, in prose, telling the agent not to run it. The newest receipt belongs to an unrelated PRD. No Linear-flow PR has ever produced one, which is why PR #23 fails its own gate.

Until this exists, PR #23 cannot merge without blocking 100% of worker PRs forever.

## Three ways to close it — the pick is 2

1. **Tell the agent to run** `/issue-closeout`**.** Rejected: an agent remembering to do a thing is not enforcement (`prompt-only-enforcement-guard.py` blocks the claim at write time), and this exact instruction already sits at `linear-worker.sh:637` saying the opposite.
2. **A deterministic writer in the converge path.** ← **the pick.** `converge.sh` already knows the moment the claim becomes true: a terminal approving verdict recorded at the PR's *current* head sha (`rework_gate` exit 0, sha-matched since [ASK-216](https://linear.app/ask-consulting/issue/ASK-216/fixreview-the-verdict-record-pins-the-head-sha-it-reviewed-so-an)). At that moment, and only then, write the receipt. Same single-writer chokepoint shape as the verdict record.
3. **Narrow the gate** so it refuses only branches whose issue has a prd-os issue spec. Rejected as the primary fix: it makes the gate quieter rather than true, and a gate that exempts the common case is decoration. Worth revisiting only if the receipt turns out to mean something the Linear flow genuinely cannot claim.

## What the receipt may honestly claim

A prd-os receipt asserts verify + review + findings triage happened. In the Linear flow the equivalent evidence already exists and is already sha-bound:

* `verified_at` — `validate` green at that sha
* `reviewed_at` — the verdict record, with its `head_sha` matching ([ASK-216](https://linear.app/ask-consulting/issue/ASK-216/fixreview-the-verdict-record-pins-the-head-sha-it-reviewed-so-an))
* `findings_triaged_at` — the minors captured to the spillover ledger, which `pr-review-agent.sh:267` already does on APPROVE WITH NITS
* `commit_sha` — the head sha the verdict pinned, never a fresh lookup

Write only what is true. If a field cannot be honestly filled from real evidence, leave it out and say so on stdout rather than stamping a value to satisfy a schema. A receipt that lies is worse than a missing one, because the gate then passes on a claim nobody made.
